description: End a model's LIVE eBay multi-variation listing: every variation leaves sale at once. The group and its offers stay on eBay as a draft, so publish_ebay_variation_listing restores the same listing. Works while listing creation is disarmed (a way off eBay is never locked), but is refused until the workspace owner switches on AI publishing. Returns withdrawn. The result echoes the workspace.

model.description: The product model: its code — the productGroupId get_product and search_products return for every article of it — or its id. Its active articles on the eBay channel become the listing's variations.

name: withdraw_ebay_variation_listing
title: End a model's eBay variation listing
